description: This script manages the review lifecycle (start, stop, clear) for components in a project by updating metadata.yaml files and generating reports. It handles date calculations, file operations, and command-line argument parsing for lifecycle actions.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components by locating metadata.yaml files excluding certain directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the full path to a component's metadata.yaml file, erroring if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears lifecycle date fields in a metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Triggers regeneration of the RAG status report by invoking an external script.
